title: 第19章 敬畏与效忠第20章 税收与暗中的谋划
slug: 军事公主不会爱上魔法科学家
lines: 马库斯伯爵府被血洗的消息，像一场无声的瘟疫，在一夜之间席卷了整个凛冬城。
没有惨叫，没有求援，三百多名私兵和一位四阶巅峰的骑士总管，就那么悄无声息地蒸发了。
取而代之的，是阿卡什那十个沉默的钢铁魔神，以及公爵府卫队冰冷的封条。
当清晨第一缕苍白的光线刺破云层，凛冬城的贵族区，那些平日里高傲的领主们，一夜未眠。
府邸内的壁炉烧得再旺，也驱不散他们骨子里的寒意。
那不是北境的严寒，而是一种名为“新秩序”的冰冷。
仅仅一个晚上，七个在北境盘根错节的家族，被连根拔起。
后续的抄家行动再没有遇到任何像样的抵抗。阿卡什的小队所到之处，剩下的六大家族府邸里的仆人和远亲，连武器都不敢拿，直接跪在地上，打开了所有的金库和密室。
公爵府门前。
天还未大亮，这里已经车水马龙。
一辆辆华贵的马车排起了长龙，从府邸大门一直延伸到街角。这些马车上，都装载着沉甸甸的礼箱，里面的珍宝几乎要溢出来。
幸存的北境贵族们，穿着自己最体面的礼服，带着最谦卑的表情，规规矩矩地在寒风中排着队，等待着公主殿下的召见。
他们每个人的脸上，都写着同一种情绪。
恐惧。
巴特利子爵擦了擦额头渗出的冷汗，他偷偷看了一眼排在前面的奥康纳伯爵。那位伯爵大人正不停地整理着自己名贵的裘皮领子，动作僵硬。
“奥康纳大人，您说……殿下会见我们吗？”巴特利子爵压低了声音，话语里带着颤抖。
奥康纳伯爵身子一僵，没有回头。
“闭嘴，等着。”
他的声音干涩，完全没有了往日的威严。
见？拿什么脸去见？昨天会议上，他们可都是冷眼旁观，甚至有人心里还盼着能给公主一个下马威。
结果，下马威变成了断头台。
现在，他们只求能用财富换来活命的机会。
时间一点点过去，府邸的大门紧闭，没有半点要打开的意思。
这种无声的等待，比任何斥责都更折磨人。每一分每一秒，都像是一把小刀，在他们脆弱的神经上反复切割。
终于，侧门打开了。
出来的是公爵府的老管家。
贵族们精神一振，纷纷露出讨好的笑容。
老管家面无表情地扫了众人一眼，声音不大，却清晰地传到每个人耳朵里。
“殿下正在处理要务，无暇接见各位。”
众人心中一沉。
“不过，”老管家话锋一转，“殿下说，各位大人忠诚的心意，她已经感受到了。礼物可以留下，各位请回吧。”
留下礼物，人滚蛋。
这姿态，比直接的羞辱还要让人难堪。
但此刻，没有一个贵族敢表露出不满。
反而，所有人都长舒了一口气。
收下礼物，就代表事情还有回旋的余地。他们争先恐后地指挥仆人将礼箱搬到门前，那副谄媚的模样，和昨日会议厅里的倨傲派若两人。
他们将忠诚的“证明”留下，灰溜溜地各自散去。
公爵府内，书房。
瑟薇娅站在巨大的落地窗前，看着门外那群贵族狼狈离去的背影，银灰色的瞳孔里没有任何波澜。
content_en:
The news of the bloodbath at Earl Marcus's Mansion was like a silent plague that swept through the entire Winter City overnight.
There was no scream, no call for help, more than three hundred private soldiers and a fourth-level peak knight general evaporated so quietly.
Instead, there were the ten silent steel demons of Akash and the cold seals of the Duke's Palace Guards.
When the first pale light in the morning pierced the clouds, the normally proud lords in the noble district of Winter City stayed awake all night.
No matter how bright the fireplace in the mansion was, it could not dispel the chill in their bones.
It was not the cold of the North, but a cold called the "New Order."
In just one night, seven intertwined families in the north were uprooted.
Subsequent house searches did not encounter any decent resistance. Wherever Akash's team went, the remaining servants and distant relatives in the mansions of the six major families did not even dare to take weapons. They knelt on the ground and opened all the vaults and secret rooms.
In front of the Duke's Palace.
It's not bright yet, but there's already a lot of traffic here.
A long queue of luxurious carriages stretched from the mansion gate to the street corner. These carriages were loaded with heavy gift boxes, and the treasures inside almost overflowed.
The surviving northern nobles, dressed in their most dignified attire and with the most humble expressions, lined up neatly in the cold wind, waiting for the summons of Her Royal Highness the Princess.
The same emotion was written on each of their faces.
fear.
Viscount Bartley wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and secretly glanced at Earl O'Connor who was in front of him. The earl was constantly adjusting his precious fur collar, his movements stiff.
"Lord O'Connor, do you think... His Highness will meet with us?" Viscount Bartley lowered his voice, his words trembling.
Earl O'Connor froze and did not look back.
"Shut up and wait."
His voice was dry, completely lacking its previous majesty.
See? What face should I use to meet you? At yesterday's meeting, they all watched with cold eyes, and some even hoped to give the princess a blow.
As a result, the show of force turned into a guillotine.
Now, all they want is to trade their wealth for a chance to survive.
Time passed little by little, and the door of the mansion was closed tightly, with no intention of opening it.
This silent waiting is more torturous than any rebuke. Every minute and every second is like a knife repeatedly cutting on their fragile nerves.
Finally, the side door opened.
The person who came out was the old butler of the Duke's Mansion.
The nobles were refreshed and all showed flattering smiles.
The old housekeeper glanced at everyone with an expressionless expression. His voice was not loud, but it reached everyone's ears clearly.
"His Royal Highness is dealing with important matters and has no time to meet with you."
Everyone's heart sank.
"However," the old housekeeper changed the topic, "Your Highness said that she has already felt your Lords' loyalty. You can keep the gifts. Please take them back."
Leave the gift and get out.
This gesture is even more embarrassing than direct humiliation.
But at this moment, no nobleman dared to show dissatisfaction.
Instead, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Accepting a gift means there is still room for maneuver. They scrambled to direct the servants to move the gift boxes to the door. Their flattering looks were no different from the arrogance in the conference hall yesterday.
They left behind the "proof" of their loyalty and dispersed in despair.
In the Duke's palace, study.
Serviya stood in front of the huge floor-to-ceiling window, looking at the backs of the nobles leaving in embarrassment outside the door. There was no wave in her silver-gray pupils.
